pkgName.description: The {@link Pkg} documentation generation should run for. Defaults to {@link App#rootPkg}.

skipTypeExamples.description:
If true, {@link DocumentationParserSpec#exampleAllLangs} will be set to false
when generating documentation for Types.

typeDocBatchOptions.description:
The batch options to use for the {@link DocSiteExport.Type.Job} that parallelizes the export
of `.c3typ` files.

topicDocBatchOptions.description:
The batch options to use for the {@link DocSiteExport.Topic.Job} that parallelizes the export
of topic `c3doc.md` files.

resolvedVersionsMap.description:
Packages written to the {@link Pkg.Store} instead of read from {@link ArtifactHub}
will only have the `{major}.{minor}.{patch}` version, not the full {@link SemanticVersion}.

When running doc gen through a [Release Management](Jarvis) pipeline, this map of
{@link Pkg#name} to its full semantic version can be used to ensure that the most
accurate version for each package is collected.
